description.zh: 搜索关键词，用于模糊匹配表名等资产信息
description.en: The keyword for a fuzzy search of asset information, such as table names.

description.zh: 每页返回条数，默认20，最大100
description.en: The number of items to return on each page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.
The sort field. Valid values: `confidence` and `entityId`. The default value is `confidence`.

description.zh: 排序方向，可选值：asc（正序）、desc（倒序），默认desc
description.en: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order. The default value is `desc`.

title.zh: 获取资产盘点涉及到的资产

descriptions.zh: 对应控制台 /knowledge/job/inventory/asset，分页查询指定盘点任务产出的表级资产信息，支持关键词筛选与排序
descriptions.en: This operation retrieves a paginated list of table-level assets generated by a specific inventory task. It corresponds to the `/knowledge/job/inventory/asset` page in the console and supports keyword filtering and sorting.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise search-inventory-asset --job-id 1001 --query order --size 20 --offset 0 --sort-by confidence --sort-order desc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise SearchInventoryAsset --region cn-hangzhou --Query order --Size 20 --SortBy confidence --SortOrder desc --JobId 1001 --Offset 0
